anchorModel.eyeDistance: Props are drawn so the guest's eye distance (center to center) equals 300 units of the prop's own size. Scale = measured eye distance in pixels / 300.
anchorModel.anchor: Face point the prop attaches to: eyes (midpoint between the eyes), nose (nose tip), mouth (mouth center), chin (bottom of the chin).
anchorModel.anchorPoint: Where that face point sits in the prop's own units (size). It may lie outside the image, e.g. below a hat.
anchorModel.rotation: Rotate the prop with the line between the eyes (head roll).
anchorModel.png: pngSize / size gives the PNG pixels per unit.
